user.title: Entity Dedup
user.description: After every restart, finds `_N` duplicate entities created because the original entity_id was still held by an orphan registry entry, removes the orphan and renames the live entity back. Default options are applied; change them later from Configure.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration is possible.

init.title: Entity Dedup options
init.description: Changes apply from the next run; nothing is reloaded or executed now.

data_description.delay_minutes: Wait after Home Assistant has started before the automatic run (1–120).
data_description.max_corrections: If more cases are eligible, nothing is corrected and you are notified (1–100). Override once with run_now ignore_limit.
data_description.log_max_entries: Older rows are dropped after each write (50–5000).
data_description.denylist_domains: Cases whose entities belong to these domains are ignored silently.
data_description.denylist_entities: Cases involving these entities (base or `_N`) are ignored silently, also by run_now.

error.invalid_domain: Invalid domain name (lowercase letters, digits, underscore).

run_now.name: Run now
run_now.description: Detects and fixes `_N` duplicate entities now. Works even with the automatic run switched off.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Only detect, log and notify; the registry is not changed.

ignore_limit.name: Ignore limit
ignore_limit.description: Ignore the maximum number of corrections for this run only.

entity_id.name: Base entity
entity_id.description: Limit the run to this base entity_id (without `_N`), taken literally.

get_log.name: Get log
get_log.description: Returns the persistent log rows, newest first.

since.name: Since
since.description: Only rows written after this moment.

already_running.message: A run is already in progress, try again later.

notify_threshold.message: Limit exceeded: {count} eligible cases > {max}. Nothing corrected; use run_now with ignore_limit to proceed.

notify_statistics.message: long-term statistics of {live} may remain orphaned (Developer tools → Statistics)

notify_aborted.message: Run stopped: a rollback failed. The snapshot is kept in the log, check the registry manually.
